name: Colony
desc:
Build a fort to survive zombie attacks and grow your production!

How to Play:

👮‍♂️  -Recruit survivors, give them jobs and weapons
☢️ -Zombies become stronger every night
⛏️ -Mine the terrain and research new technologies!
💀 -Try and survive as long as you can, good luck

Support development by liking and favoriting!

⚔ Join our community for updates, tips and team up!

Game is in Alpha so expect some bugs and report them to us please!
